title: Onboarding Kickoff - Acme Corp & Redwood
summary: Kickoff for Redwood onboarding with Acme Corp to review onboarding checklist, account provisioning, security requirements (SSO/SAML, KMS), networking (VPC/private), staging vs prod, Dedicated vs Hosted tradeoffs, and initial success criteria and timeline. Action items assigned for provisioning API keys, sharing SOC2/security docs, and scheduling architecture deep dive.
action_items: Lena Ortiz: Send onboarding runbook + account setup checklist by 2025-01-31
Olivia Chen: Schedule architecture deep-dive (networking and capacity) with Acme SREs by 2025-02-03
Samir Patel: Provision staging API keys and demo project, ETA 2025-01-30
Ethan Cole: Share internal SIEM/ingestion requirements and confirm log retention constraints by 2025-02-04
Raj Patel & Priya Singh: Provide sample workload profile and SLOs for pilot by 2025-02-05
next_steps: Send SOC2 and security questionnaire (redwood-sec.zip link placeholder)
Provision staging workspace and API keys
Set up SSO/SAML integration call with Acme IDP team

transcript:
Meeting header:
Date: 2025-01-28
Start: 15:00 PST
Duration: ~52 minutes
Attendees: Lena Ortiz (Redwood AE), Samir Patel (Redwood CSM), Olivia Chen (Redwood SE); Raj Patel (Acme Head of ML), Maya Thompson (Acme Platform Eng), Ethan Cole (Acme Security), Priya Singh (Acme Product)

Summary: onboarding kickoff for Acme to get Redwood staged and scoped for a pilot. Talked through security, networking, provisioning, pilot metrics and next steps.

[00:00] Lena Ortiz (Redwood AE): Okay hi everyone thanks for joining, really appreciate it. quick intros then we'll go through the checklist.
[00:08] Raj Patel (Acme): Hey, Raj here, thanks. we'll be driving the ML bits on our side.
[00:11] Maya Thompson (Acme): Maya, platform engineering. I'll own the infra pieces.
[00:15] Ethan Cole (Acme Security): Ethan, security. I'll ask the usual questions later.
[00:20] Priya Singh (Acme Product): Priya, product, focusing on success metrics.
[00:25] Lena: Awesome. Samir and Olivia from Redwood are here to help run the onboarding. Samir do you want to kickoff the agenda?
[00:30] Samir Patel (Redwood CSM): Yep thanks Lena. agenda today: account provisioning, sso/saml, vpc vs hosted, dedicated sizing for the pilot, security docs, and timeline. we'll assign action items at the end. should be about 45-60 minutes.
[01:05] Olivia Chen (Redwood SE): I'll focus on networking and the capacity considerations, happy to deep dive after the main checklist.
[01:20] Raj: Sounds good. quick context: we're planning a 6-week pilot to validate inference latency and cost across ~3 models. expected qps is small to start (10-20) but token volume might spike on demo days to 5-10k tokens per minute.
[01:40] Priya: Success criteria: latency under 250ms p95 for short prompts, and unit cost under our target — we'll provide exact numbers. also data residency for logs matters.
[02:05] Lena: Good. Samir, provisioning — what's the typical flow?
[02:15] Samir: We'll send an onboarding runbook, plus provisioning form. we usually create a staging workspace and generate API keys for you; keys can be scoped to a project. question on whether you want hosted API access first or go straight to private. most customers start hosted for speed, then move to dedicated/private if they need VPC or stricter data controls.
[02:45] Maya: We prefer VPC and private, but for speed we'd like hosted staging while we validate. is that supported?
[02:55] Olivia: yes you can do hosted staging while we provision a private deployment in parallel. just note that private deploys take longer (more security approvals, infra).
[03:10] Ethan: On security, we need SOC2, ISO certs, encryption at rest and in transit, KMS integration details, and audit log formats. do you provide SIEM-ready logs?
[03:30] Lena: we have SOC2 reports and security pack. Olivia will share the KMS integration notes and audit log schema. logs can stream to your S3 or to our audit endpoint depending on deployment.
[03:50] Olivia: small caveat — in hosted mode we retain telemetry for X days by default, and we can configure longer retention as an add-on. if you go private, you control retention fully.
[04:10] Raj: ok. on the technical side, we have a KV-cache heavy pattern and long-context chats, does the runtime support longer KV cache and quantized models?
[04:25] Olivia: yes, the runtime supports kv cache management and quantization-friendly paths. sometimes the transcript says K V cash in older exports, so apologies if docs look weird. model selection for long context is an ops conversation — we recommend a model tuned for long context or chunking.
[04:50] Raj: Great. price question — how does dedicated capacity pricing work for pilot-level commits?
[04:58] Samir: Dedicated is monthly reserved capacity; for pilots we often do a short-term reserved pool or a burst policy. we'll send an estimate after we see your sample workload.
[05:20] Priya: We have compliance deadlines and a procurement window in mid-march; we need to know whether Redwood can meet that.
[05:30] Lena: we'll aim to get the SOC2 docs and an initial estimate in a week. dedicated lead time is typically 4-6 weeks from confirmed contract, but hosted doesn't need that.
[05:45] Maya: networking question — does private require peering or do you support transit via VPN?
[05:52] Olivia: we support VPC peering, Transit Gateway, and VPN options. for on-prem we also support a managed connector. we'll outline pros/cons in the architecture doc.
[06:10] Ethan: For KMS, do you integrate with our AWS KMS or need a separate HSM?
[06:18] Olivia: we support AWS KMS integration for key wrapping and can offer HSM options for higher compliance tiers. we'll send the KMS integration guide.
[06:35] Raj: Another technical: can we pin model versions and have automatic fallbacks to smaller models if capacity constrained?
[06:45] Olivia: yes, pinning and routing policies are supported — you can set fallbacks by policy (latency vs cost); we'll include config examples. sometimes the auto transcript flips names like Redwood Runtime to Redwood Runtim, sorry.
[07:05] Priya: Regarding telemetry, how granular are the cost/latency breakdowns? we want token-level cost and per-route dashboards.
[07:18] Samir: we provide token-level breakdowns, per-route/model dashboards, and tracing hooks. we can export to your cost tools as CSV or push to your reporting store.
[07:40] Raj: For the pilot we'll need a small benchmark run. can Redwood spin up a dedicated bench with 10k tokens/day?
[07:50] Lena: yes we'll provision a staging bench. Samir will handle keys and Olivia will run the bench with you.
[08:05] Maya: Do you have a recommended prompt set for evaluating hallucination/regression?
[08:12] Olivia: we have an eval kit and can share templates; we'll attach them to the runbook.
[08:30] Ethan: On audit logs, what's the retention and format? JSON? can we forward to our SIEM?
[08:37] Olivia: JSON lines, we can push to your S3 or via an HTTP endpoint. retention configurable, forwarding supported.
[09:00] Raj: Who will be our primary contact for operational issues during the pilot?
[09:06] Samir: Samir will be your CSM for pilot ops, Lena for commercial, and Olivia for deep technical.
[09:12] Priya: Great. timeline check: so keys this week, staging bench next week, arch deep-dive within two weeks, pilot starts in 3 weeks?
[09:25] Lena: that sounds feasible. we'll aim for provisioning by 01/30, deep-dive by 02/03, pilot start 02/10.
[09:35] Maya: fine but procurement needs the pricing sheet — can you send a preliminary estimate?
[09:40] Samir: yes we'll send a pilot estimate and a dedicated commit estimate for procurement.
[10:00] -- 10 minute tech deep-dive reserved but the call keeps moving --
[12:45] Olivia: quick note on model sizing: if you expect spikes to 10k tokens/minute, batching and prefix caching will reduce cost. we can run a simulation once you share workload traces.
[13:10] Raj: we'll send a sample trace with anonymized prompts.
[13:20] Ethan: security follow-ups: can we get an endpoint for penetration testing?
[13:26] Lena: yes, we provide a testing window and coordinate with security for pen tests; remit a scope and schedule.
[13:40] Priya: also need SSO test - we use Okta; what's the flow?
[13:46] Olivia: standard SAML 2.0 flow. we'll schedule a SSO integration call with your IdP team.
[14:05] Raj: For the staging environment, will logs contain user-level PII? we need masking options.
[14:14] Olivia: we can configure masking or disable persistent logs for staging. will document options.
[14:30] Maya: Any gotchas on RBAC? we want granular access per team and token scoping.
[14:36] Samir: RBAC supports role-based policies and token scoping to projects; we'll share policy templates.
[14:55] (inaudible) Speaker 1: uh yeah can we also get a checklist for the procurement team?
[15:02] Lena: yes we'll include a procurement checklist with pricing and contract timelines.
[15:20] Priya: If we need a private deployment, what are lead times?
[15:25] Olivia: generally 4-6 weeks after contract and network approvals. if it's an on-prem package it can be longer based on your change windows.
[15:40] Raj: Are refunds or credits available if SLOs are missed?
[15:46] Samir: That's part of the SLA in the dedicated contract; we'll include SLOs and remedies in the procurement docs.
[16:05] Lena: ok let's recap next steps. Samir, keys and runbook?
[16:10] Samir: I'll send keys + runbook by 01/30.
[16:15] Olivia: I'll share KMS guide, audit log schema, SSO steps, and schedule the architecture deep-dive for week of Feb 3.
[16:25] Lena: I'll send a pricing spreadsheet and procurement checklist.
[16:30] Raj: we'll send workload traces and our SLO definitions by Feb 5.
[16:35] Ethan: security will compile a list of questions and pen-test scope by Feb 4.
[16:45] Priya: sounds good. any blockers?
[16:50] Maya: Just internal approvals but otherwise no blockers.
[16:55] Lena: Great. we'll follow up with calendar invites for the deep-dive and SSO call. thanks everyone.
[17:05] -- small crosstalk/closing pleasantries --
[17:30] Lena: Thanks again. meeting adjourned.

Action items (transcript copy):
- Lena: Send procurement checklist and pricing sheet (by 2025-01-30)
- Samir: Provision staging workspace and API keys (by 2025-01-30)
- Olivia: Share KMS integration guide, audit log schema, SSO steps; schedule architecture deep-dive (by 2025-02-03)
- Raj & Priya: Share workload sample and SLOs (by 2025-02-05)
- Ethan: Security questions and pen-test scope (by 2025-02-04)

Referenced docs/links: onboarding-runbook.pdf (link placeholder), redwood-sec-pack.zip (link placeholder), pilot-pricing-template.xlsx (link placeholder)

End transcript.
